consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1993-08-21 show at Autzen Stadium featured some standout performances, particularly the 'Standing on the Moon' which is frequently hailed as one of the best versions ever. While some reviewers noted that the first set was short and somewhat ordinary, the energy and quality of the second set, especially with Jerry's guitar work, left a lasting impression on many attendees.
standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 58 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the show for its highlights, others felt the first set was lacking, leading to a mixed overall sentiment despite the strong second set.
